newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine bourse freezes Atok share price.
newsitem.headline: Philippine bourse freezes Atok share price.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) said on Monday it froze the share price of Atok Big Wedge Co Inc at midsession after it rose by 10 centavos, or 47.62 percent, to 31 centavos.
The bourse automatically freezes fluctuations of a share price if it rises by 50 percent or goes down by 40 percent within a single trading day.
The PSE said Atok shares could only be traded at 31 centavos or below.
Atok was recently converted to a holding firm from a mining company and one broker said there was talk of a buy in.
Most Philippine firms converted to holding companies have ventured into the booming property business.
Other brokers said the stock was rarely traded.
A total of 6.55 million shares had changed hands.
